newsitem.title: USA: Cleveland Fed median CPI up 0.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Cleveland Fed median CPI up 0.3 pct in April.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland said on Thursday its median Consumer Price Index rose 0.3 percent in April after edging up 0.2 percent in March.
"The median CPI rose 0.3 percent in April, 3.6 percent at an annualized rate," the Cleveland Fed said.
Year-over-year, the median CPI was up 2.7 percent in April.
The median CPI is a measure of core inflation that excludes items whose price changes depart markedly from the performance of most CPI components as compiled by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
The BLS reported on Thursday the CPI rose 0.1 percent in April at a 2.2-percent annualized rate, and the core CPI, ex-food and ex-energy, rose 0.3 percent at a 3.6-percent annualized rate.
